structured.reason: The description contains hedged and caveated wording that the strict criterion rules out. "For best results, follow with your favorite Garnier Whole Blends conditioner" implies the bar alone does not deliver the best results, which is a conditional caveat about performance. "Shoppers often praise the rich lather" adds a hedge ("often") to the praise. "wash with more control and less drip" frames drip as a problem the product only reduces, which is a minimizing reassurance tied to a review concern (the reviewer who said the bar "does not drip" and the note about the bar being used for kids). "Lasts up to 40 washes" is a spec, but the "up to" qualifier, combined with reviews complaining the bar wears down faster than advertised, reads as a hedge. Under the strict standard, any of these is enough to fail.
